entries.name: Suzanne Goldberg Savio

expected.charges: Trespass — the December 2-3, 1964 Sproul Hall sit-in

updates.sentence: A 45-day jail sentence was later excused; she received two years of probation and a fine. The December 3, 1964 arrest remains documented, but the length of initial detention is unresolved. The suspended term is not counted as time served.

entries.rationale: FBI Mario Savio Part 08, Identification Record section, cites Daily Californian October 27, 1967 page 3 reporting Suzanne excused from the 45-day jail term. Seth Rosenfeld separately reports suspension to care for her chronically ill child. Remove the unsupported 45-day actual-custody total; retain arrest, conviction and profile. Do not treat the newspaper publication date as release or assert zero initial detention.
